test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a feature of money?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Perishable**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Money is a commodity accepted by general consent as a** medium of economic exchange**.
 
• It is the medium in which prices and values are expressed
 
• Money serves as a **medium of exchange, as a store of value, and as a unit of account**.
 
• As a medium of exchange money facilitates transactions and **provides general acceptability**.
 
• In order to be a medium of exchange money must **hold its value over time and have higher liquidity** in the market.
 
• Money also functions as a** unit of account**, providing a common measure of the value of goods and services being exchanged.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Functions of money**:

 
 
• **Primary Function**

 
 
• Medium of Exchange.
 
• Measure of Value 
 
 
 
• **Secondary Functions**
 
 
• Standard of deferred payments.
 
• Store of value.
 
• Transfer of Value.
 
 
 
• **Contingent Functions**
 
 
• Measurement of National Income.
 
• Imports liquidity to wealth
 
• Estimation of macroeconomic variables
